project: Gauntlet3 rebuild v2 - 12 exoplanets, 160wpm, new style bar

reference.title: most classified places (listicle)
reference.note: Style/pacing/motion bar only. NOT an exoplanet video. Our content stays 12 planets.

measured.title_font: hand-drawn monoline marker, all caps, centred
measured.animation: elements pop in fully-formed in 1 frame, occasionally slide/rotate 0.2s, then long hold
measured.font: Comic Neue Bold (OFL, work/fonts/ComicNeue-Bold.ttf) - verified at 46px cap height
measured.devices: red marker arrows/boxes/X, yellow+red short labels, speech bubbles, character close-ups

target.register: white background, pure black ink, flat vector
target.density: 1-3 elements per frame, no narration lines on screen
target.budget_rationale: match the bar's ~15 min at our slower 160wpm; a ~30% cut from the 2842-word v1 scripts, which is the 'less clutter, simpler' the brief asks for

wasp127b.title: the fastest winds in the galaxy

gliese436b.title: burning ice, dragging a glowing tail

koi55.title: the planet that survived being eaten

fomalhautb.title: the dust-shepherd that may not be there

psoj3185.title: the rogue, alone in the dark

psrb1257.title: the planets around a dead star

pipeline.type: per-beat TTS + closed-form atempo pacing solve
pipeline.pause_squeeze: internal silences >=0.16s cut to 0.07s before the solve
pipeline.brightness: 3dB high shelf @3.5kHz, undoing atempo darkening (centroid 1248->1190Hz) -- targeted at UNDAMAGE, not at the contaminated reference centroid
pipeline.solve: gap chosen first, required_speech = words/170*60 - gap*n_gaps, f = raw/required (f<1 slows)
pipeline.render: v2engine pop-and-hold compositor, 60fps, timed from whisper word onsets
pipeline.subjects: lib/v2subjects.py flat-vector subjects on white page, 6px ink wobble
pipeline.assembly_fps_note: bridges were 30fps against 60fps segments; fixed to 60 and verify_output now asserts stream params, because duration agreement alone did not catch it
